title: Work order lines Create & Edit allows adding, editing, moving parts, authorizing and managing part requests
custom_preconds: 1. A user has a role with Work orders View, Work order lines Create & Edit (Delete OFF), and View mode Full View.
custom_steps:
1. Open a work order and add a new line.
  2. Edit line details (labor hours, parts, notes).
  3. Move a part from one line to another on the same work order.
  4. Authorize a line.
  5. Manage a parts request on a line.
custom_expected: All of these actions work and the lines are saved.
evidence: UI (role WO View + Work order lines Create&Edit): the lines screen shows New Line + Build Lines — the user can add/edit lines (add and line management affordances present). screenshot wol-wolce.
